lines.name: Missives
lines.begins: Collect <Alias=Item>

lines.name: Miscellaneous
lines.begins: Giraud Gemane of the Bards College has found a clue to the location of the legendary drum of Rjorn. He's asked me to go to Halldir's Cairn and retrieve it.

lines.name: Side quests
lines.begins: Dummy entry to end this quest.

lines.name: Favor Quests Separated
lines.begins: Kill the bandit leader located at <Alias=BountyLocation>

lines.name: VIGILANT - English Translation (Plus Voiced Addon)
lines.begins: Join the Vigilants of Stendarr

lines.name: Missives - Voice and Quest Expansion
lines.begins: QuickStart

lines.name: Dawnguard
lines.begins: I've learned of a group of vampire hunters known as the Dawnguard. It seems they are looking for new recruits.

lines.name: Betalille's Hammerfell Quests Bundle - The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
lines.source: Betalille's Hammerfell Quests Bundle - The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
lines.begins: A merchant in Solstheim wants to travel to Hammerfell and create a shop for dunmer goods there. I agreed to accompany him in Hammerfell.

lines.name: Dark Brotherhood
lines.begins: I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins.

lines.name: Missives - Gray Cowl Patch
lines.begins: Collect <Alias=Item>

lines.name: Missives - Solstheim Patch SE
lines.begins: Collect <Alias=Item>

lines.name: Missives - Wyrmstooth Patch
lines.begins: Collect <Alias=Item>

lines.name: Thieves Guild
lines.begins: Brynjolf in Riften seems to be involved in some nefarious activities and has convinced me to take part in one of his schemes.

lines.name: ccBGSSSE001-Fish
lines.begins: I met Viriya, one of the employees at the Riften Fishery. She handed me a bounty letter and seemed rather frustrated. I should see what it has to say.

lines.name: College of Winterhold
lines.begins: I've found the College of Winterhold, where mages study the arcane arts in Skyrim. If I want to learn more about magic, I'll need to join their ranks.

lines.name: Companions
lines.begins: If I want to become a member of the Companions, I have to speak to their leader, Kodlak Whitemane, in Whiterun.

lines.name: Adventurer's Start - An Alternate Perspective Addon
lines.source: Adventurer's Start - An Alternate Perspective Addon
lines.begins: I've been ambushed by a group of bandits. I need to fight my way out of this to survive.

lines.name: New Beginnings - Alternate Perspective Extension
lines.begins: I have finally arrived at the Eldergleam Sanctuary. It's even more beautiful than I had imagined! I knew coming here was the right choice. I think I'll stay here for a while before I travel on...

lines.name: Wyrmstooth
lines.begins: An imperial courier named Theodyn Bienne has requested I speak to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun as soon as possible.

lines.name: Main Quest
lines.begins: I have been captured by the Empire and sentenced to death alongside the Stormcloak rebels. We were taken to Helgen, but before I could be executed a dragon appeared and attacked the town. I need to find some way to escape.

lines.name: Civil War
lines.begins: In order to prove myself to Legate Rikke, I am to clear out the bandits living at Fort Hraggstad.

lines.name: Meridia's Order ESMIFIED
lines.begins: I have been approached by Paladin Marith of Meridia's Order. Her leader, High Priestess Alara wishes to speak with me.

lines.name: More to Say - Main
lines.begins: ; Hilde admonished

lines.name: Capital Windhelm Expansion
lines.begins: Wilhelm has asked me to deliver a purchase agreement to Higil who lives in the Upper Valunstrad, west of the Palace. I can place the document on his desk if he is not at home.

lines.name: Gore - A Companion Mod
lines.begins: I should speak to Gore about upgrading his personal equipment.

lines.name: Katana - Journey in the Shadows
lines.begins: Megara mentioned a carrot at Chillfurrow Farm. I wonder what's so special about it. I suppose I should find out.

lines.name: Penitus Oculatus
lines.begins: I've joined the Penitus Oculatus, The Empire's security and law enforcers, as well the Emperor's bodyguards. I should speak to Commander Maro for assignments.

lines.name: Journey to Baan Malur and Morrowind
lines.source: Journey to Baan Malur and Morrowind
lines.begins: finished quest

lines.name: Remiel-Custom Voiced Follower
lines.begins: I was attacked by an assassin. I should investigate the body for any clues as to why.

lines.name: ACDB - Additional Contracts for the Dark Brotherhood
lines.source: ACDB - Additional Contracts for the Dark Brotherhood
plugins: Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp
lines.opening: Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000822
lines.begins: I have accepted an additional contract to kill Braith in Whiterun.

Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000FE8
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000E51
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000DCA
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:00081B
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000858
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000E3C
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:00082B
Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp:000FDA

lines.name: College of Winterhold - Quest Expansion
lines.begins: After learning the Waterbreathing spell from Tolfdir, I have been instructed to talk to Arniel Gane.

lines.name: Rob's Bug Fixes - Capital Whiterun Expansion
lines.source: Rob's Bug Fixes - Capital Whiterun Expansion
lines.begins: I've bought the deed to Bluesky Hall in the town of Whiterun, and all accompanying goods. The hall is located in Whiterun, in the city district behind the Hall of the Dead. I should probably pay my new property a visit.

lines.name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal - 10th anniversary
lines.source: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal - 10th anniversary
lines.begins: I had a strange vision in my mind. Also I know where to go now.

lines.name: Dragonborn
lines.begins: I've been attacked by a group of cultists. I need to see if they have any evidence of what prompted this assault.

lines.name: Undeath Remastered - CLEANED ESMIFIED
lines.begins: I have found and read the Black Book called "Whispers of the Veil" deep within Scourg Barrow, and found myself in Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha. The forbidden knowledge hidden here may be the secrets of the ritual the necromancer Antioch was seeking. I should press on to uncover it, or read the book again to escape.

lines.name: INIGO
lines.begins: Inigo has been suffering from strange and painful visions. He believes that Snowpoint Beacon is near the source of these visions. We are going there to investigate.

lines.name: Listen - Dark Brotherhood Radiant Quests
lines.begins: Startup stage

lines.name: The Gift Of Saturalia
lines.begins: I've agreed to help Niklas the Trader with his Saturalia celebrations. He has five tasks for me to help people around Skyrim.

lines.name: Belethor's Sister - Quest
lines.begins: Belethor told me he sold his sister <alias=waifu> for money and has asked me to get her back. Belethor told me he sold <alias=waifu> to Ysolda.

lines.name: Serana Dialogue Expansion
lines.begins: Meeko

lines.name: Serana Dialogue Expansion - Romance ESL
lines.begins: I wanted to take Serana on a dance, but I made her uncomfortable. I should wait until tomorrow and apologize.

lines.name: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
lines.source: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
plugins: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp
lines.opening: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:099D19
lines.begins: Staada told me about a riot in the Shivering Isles' prison. She wants me to travel with her to the Asylum and help fight off the prisoners, before the Root does any more damage to Nirn.
quests: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:099D1B
Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:099D18
Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:099D19
Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:09EF5F
Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp:099D1A

lines.name: The Tools of Kagrenac ESMIFIED
lines.begins: I've received an anonymous note from the courier. I should read it and see what it's regarding.

lines.name: Lucien - Immersive Fully Voiced Male Follower
lines.source: Lucien - Immersive Fully Voiced Male Follower
lines.begins: Lucien's resonant sphere has started making a strange noise, which Lucien tells me is a warning of some kind indicating that Dumzbthar is under attack. We should go there as quickly as possible.

lines.name: Requiem - The Roleplaying Overhaul (No Messages ESLIFIED)
lines.source: Requiem - The Roleplaying Overhaul (No Messages ESLIFIED)
lines.begins: I have discovered the fragment of a poem. That seems interesting. Perhaps I should explore at the Bard's College to see what this is all about.

lines.name: Siege at Icemoth
lines.begins: While wandering the coast, I found the corpse of a mercenary by a beached sailboat. In his clutches I found a journal that mentioned an old abandoned Imperial fort known as "Fort Icemoth", far north of Jehanna just over the horizon. The journal also mentions a large presence of undead. I should investigate.

lines.name: The Frozen Heart - Quest Mod
lines.begins: I purchased a strange Snow Elf mirror from Belethor's General Goods. I should investigate the nature of this mirror.

lines.name: The Welkynar Knight - Quest
lines.begins: I received a mysterious note requesting a secret meeting at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun.

lines.name: (BEST EVIL FOLLOWER) Follower Dialogue Expansion - Fura Bloodmouth
lines.source: (BEST EVIL FOLLOWER) Follower Dialogue Expansion - Fura Bloodmouth
lines.begins: I will accompany Fura Bloodmouth to Solitude and meet her mother.

lines.name: Fists of Fury - Skyrim
lines.begins: I've talked to Falion about the brawling tournament. He told me to go to the Summoning Stones outside of Morthal.

lines.name: Gravewind - ESMIFIED
lines.begins: I touched a light left by Richter, letting Gravewind fall into the abyss and freeing the souls enthralled within. I have to escape before I disappear with the rest of the realm.

lines.name: More to do in the Soul Cairn
lines.source: More to do in the Soul Cairn
lines.begins: A soul in the Soul Cairn wants me to get their soul gem back. I'm not so sure about who he is, but maybe I should help him.

lines.name: Arena - Markarth Side Town
lines.begins: I've met a strange Khajiit named Grit-dar in Markarth Side who has asked me to retrieve something for him from Morvunskar Crypts that resides near Windhelm.

lines.name: ccbgssse025-advdsgs
lines.begins: Free the Elytra Nymph

lines.name: ccffbsse001-imperialdragon
lines.begins: Stormbear

lines.name: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Faralda
lines.begins: Faralda, the Professor of Destruction School in the College of Winterhold, wants  me to bring a letter from her to Vekel the Man in the Ragged Flagon in Riften. He will help deliver it to her aunt Eilonwy.

lines.name: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map
lines.source: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map
plugins: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map.esp
lines.opening: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map.esp:000800
lines.begins: Hunt down animals at <Alias=AnimalDenLocation>
quests: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map.esp:000800
Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map.esp:00081E

lines.name: Miasma
lines.begins: I met an Argonian called Haj-Xul at The Retching Netch in Raven Rock. He claims he is a member of the An-Xileel clan in Black Marsh and has hired me to assist him in capturing a criminal from House Telvanni who might have recently arrived in Solstheim.

lines.name: The Forgotten City
lines.begins: A courier tracked me down and gave me a letter. I should read it.

lines.name: A Daedra's Best Friend
lines.begins: I ran in to a talking dog named Barbas who said he wanted my help. He's waiting outside Haemar's Shame.

lines.name: A Forlorn Hope - an addon for Seeking The Cure
lines.source: A Forlorn Hope - an addon for Seeking The Cure
lines.begins: I have received a letter from Falion describing a way to create "daedric essence". To do this I need to locate the Aetherium Forge first.

lines.name: A Night To Remember
lines.begins: I have awoken in the Temple Of Dibella in Markarth. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared.

lines.name: After the Civil War - Siege Damage Repairs
lines.source: After the Civil War - Siege Damage Repairs
lines.begins: It's time to rebuild and repairs to the damaged cities will soon begin. It won't be long until they are back to normal.

lines.name: Alternate Perspective
lines.begins: Survive

lines.name: Bards College Excavation
lines.begins: Clear Dead Men's Respite.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling
lines.begins: I am to lead someone to the Shrine of Boethiah, instruct them to touch the Pillar of Sacrifice, and once trapped by its magic, slay them. If I do this Boethiah will appear.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling - Alternate Questline
lines.begins: I have agreed to help Rudin Filaro, a Dark Elf intent on visiting the Temple of Mara located in the mountains northeast of Kynesgrove. He has hired to escort him as the road is known to be dangerous.

lines.name: Caught Red Handed - Quest Expansion
lines.begins: Talk to Tythis

lines.name: CC Tundra Homestead - Tweaks and Enhancements
plugins: CC Tundra Homestead - Tweaks and Enhancements.esp
lines.opening: CC Tundra Homestead - Tweaks and Enhancements.esp:00000A
lines.begins: I have found a Thalmor Dossier mentioning Nazeem and Ahlam. Accourding to the Dossier, the couple are informants to the Thalmor, to spy on Whiterun and its Jarl. I should bring this information to the Jarl.
quests: CC Tundra Homestead - Tweaks and Enhancements.esp:00000A

lines.name: ccbgssse002-exoticarrows
lines.begins: Read the Letter from Calcelmo

lines.name: ccbgssse014-spellpack01
lines.begins: I've heard tales of a long-lost ancient library of spell tomes, rumored to be somewhere in the area of Winterhold.  I should explore the area and see what I can find.

lines.name: ccbgssse018-shadowrend
lines.begins: An inner voice is telling me I must confront a darkness within myself. I am drawn toward a geyser pool in Eastmarch. Perhaps answers lie there.

lines.name: ccbgssse038-bowofshadows
lines.begins: With the death of King Torygg, it seems not even the Jarls are safe in Skyrim, and security comes at a premium. Given the need for capable warriors, I should speak with the steward and see if he has any work for me.

lines.name: ccbgssse067-daedinv
lines.begins: I found the Oblivion Gate and defeated the leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos. It appears this was an elaborate ritual designed to deceive me, and killing Vonos was the final step. I have become an unwitting instrument of Mehrunes Dagon, and my actions have opened the Oblivion Gate.

lines.name: cceejsse004-hall
lines.begins: Couriers often deliver notices to travelers across Skyrim. If I head to a major hold, perhaps I will receive information that may concern me.

lines.name: cceejsse005-cave
lines.begins: I received a letter from a courier mentioning a banquet feast is happening at a large manor south of Frostflow Lighthouse. I arrived at the home and spoke to the waiter, who gave me a menu. The feast appears to be an elaborate trap to feed on a handful of noble guests. After finishing the guests and a surprise group of Dawnguard members, I should now speak to the waiter.

lines.name: cckrtsse001_altar
lines.begins: In my travels, I've heard strange tales about hagravens performing rituals near Falkreath. I should head to the inn there and see what information I can turn up.

lines.name: ccmtysse001-knightsofthenine
lines.begins: I've discovered the whereabouts of a powerful artifact that the once belonged to the fabled Divine Crusader. I should try and reunite all the missing relics.

lines.name: ccrmssse001-necrohouse
lines.begins: I've heard rumors of necromancer activity in one of the old abandoned forts. I should investigate to see what I can find.

lines.name: ccvsvsse004-beafarmer
lines.begins: <Alias=FarmLocation> near Rorikstead is reportedly haunted by ghosts that harass travelers on the road. The Jarl of Whiterun Hold is offering the plantation itself as a reward for anyone who can lay the spirits to rest. I should head to <Alias=FarmLocation> to investigate.

lines.name: Civil War Champions - Reduced Cut
lines.begins: Pick up champion armor from your commanding officer

lines.name: Defeat the Dragon Cult
lines.begins: Esbern has noted the location of several Dragon Priests, whose loyalty to Alduin means they must be killed before I face Alduin, less they join their strength with his.

lines.name: Destroy the Acolyte Priests
lines.begins: <Alias.ShortName=Storn> has said that to ensure the land is completely cleansed of Miraak's influence, I should seek out and destroy his three Acolyte Priests, who are each sealed within different tombs around the island of Solstheim.

lines.name: Discerning the Transmundane
lines.begins: I've been given a book of bizarre ramblings about Elder Scrolls, written by Septimus Signus. He claims to have spent time at the Winterhold Arcanaeum.

lines.name: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Erik the Slayer
lines.source: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Erik the Slayer
lines.begins: Erik and I will clear <Alias=Location> as his trial to join the Companions.

lines.name: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Jenassa
lines.begins: Jenassa would like to travel to the tower where she met her first love.

lines.name: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Mjoll the Lioness
lines.source: Follower Dialogue Expansion - Mjoll the Lioness
lines.begins: Aerin, the friend of Mjoll, would like to prove that he is a real warrior and win Mjoll the Lioness's heart.

lines.name: Granite Hill - ESLIFIED LUX PATCH
lines.begins: A courier handed me a note from someone in Granite Hill. I should read it.

lines.name: Heart of the Reach - New Quest - Dungeon - Weapons - 3 Creature Variants - Ring - Spell
lines.source: Heart of the Reach - New Quest - Dungeon - Weapons - 3 Creature Variants - Ring - Spell
lines.begins: I have talked to Gwilym, a priest I met in the Silver Blood Inn in Markarth. He has tasked me with healing the "Heart" in a cave in the reach. I should go there and make the remedy he provided.

lines.name: Ill Met By Moonlight
lines.begins: There are stories in Falkreath of a strange vagrant who savagely killed a little girl.

lines.name: Leaps of Faith - A Misc Quest
lines.source: Leaps of Faith - A Misc Quest
lines.begins: Find and complete the remaining 11 Leaps of Faith.

lines.name: Legends of Aetherium - New Dungeon - Quest - Armour - Weapons
lines.source: Legends of Aetherium - New Dungeon - Quest - Armour - Weapons
lines.begins: I have heard of an excavation into a lost Dwemer ruin offering gold as a reward for work aiding the crew. I should go an investigate to see if there is any work still available.

lines.name: Mehrunes Dagon's Shrine Unlocked - Pieces of the Past Quest Alternative - Voiced
lines.source: Mehrunes Dagon's Shrine Unlocked - Pieces of the Past Quest Alternative - Voiced
lines.begins: Silus has agreed to let me reforge Mehrunes Dagon's Razor without seeking the Daedric Prince's help. Successfully reforging the Razor will require me being skilled in working with both enchanted and Daedric materials.

lines.name: Mephala's Curse - Whispering Door Quest Addon
lines.source: Mephala's Curse - Whispering Door Quest Addon
lines.begins: I have acquired the Ebony Blade, the legendary artifact of Mephala. I must decide whether to keep this powerful weapon or seek a means to destroy it. To destroy it, I would need a fire more intense than those that stoke the Skyforge.

lines.name: More To Say - Sissel's Book Quest
lines.source: More To Say - Sissel's Book Quest
lines.begins: Find one <Alias=SisselBookAlias>.

lines.name: Myrwatch - Tweaks and Enhancements
lines.begins: As I entered the Vestibule of Myrwatch, I found a strange note. It turns out Myrwatch has been further sealed off and actually needs to be purchased from Tolfdir in the college of Winterhold. For him to deem me worthy for purchasing it, I either need to complete Shalidor's Maze and acquire the Diadem of the Savant, or find some other way of convincing him.

lines.name: Ordinator - Perks of Skyrim
lines.begins: Find the Spirit Teacher

lines.name: Pieces of the Past
lines.begins: Silus Vesuius, the owner of a museum dedicated to the Mythic Dawn cult, wants to hire me for a job. He'll give me the details inside his house in Dawnstar.

lines.name: Redeeming Fultheim - A Blades Quest Addon
lines.source: Redeeming Fultheim - A Blades Quest Addon
lines.begins: I've come across Fultheim, an old man who I believe may have been a member of the Blades in the past. However, he does seem to want to talk about it. I should ask Delphine about him.

lines.name: Requiem - Improved Spell Learning
lines.begins: Alteration - Novice

lines.name: Respawn - Soulslike Edition
lines.begins: When I was defeated, I dropped some of my belongings. I need to retrieve them. If I fail a second time without retrieving them, they will surely be lost forever. I need to be careful.

lines.name: Return Aegisbane
lines.begins: Retrieve Aegisbane

lines.name: Revealing Rune
lines.begins: Decision stage

lines.name: SIRENROOT - Deluge of Deceit
lines.begins: The Black-Briars sent out a notice for diving work to collect ingredients at the bottom of Lake Honrich. I should speak to Frissa Black-Briar at Elgrim's Elixirs if I want to accept the job.

lines.name: Skyrim's Paraglider - ZERO
lines.begins: A man fell out of the sky and died on impact. I should investigate.

lines.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare - New Daedric Prince Quest
lines.source: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare - New Daedric Prince Quest
lines.begins: Ralforn has informed me of his wife Gretska who has disapeared over night and has told me of Gretska's common spots, I should look to see if I can find her or any clues at these spots.

lines.name: Snazzy Misc Locations
lines.begins: I decided not to buy the lodge right now

lines.name: Snazzy Riften AIO
lines.begins: accept Manor

lines.name: Solstheim Earthquakes SE
lines.begins: Show settings

lines.name: Song of the Green (Auri Follower)
lines.begins: Auri is homesick, and you've decided to cheer her up. Perhaps taking her to the most beautiful places in Skyrim might relieve her longing?

lines.name: The Black Star
lines.begins: Aranea, a priestess of Azura, says I am destined to find "an elven man, who can turn the brightest star as black as night." She believes he is in Winterhold.

lines.name: The Book of Love - Fastred's Awakening
lines.source: The Book of Love - Fastred's Awakening
lines.begins: Fastred wants to leave Ivarstead with Bassianus, but her father won't allow it. She seems conflicted about her choices. Perhaps there's another solution.

lines.name: The Break of Dawn
lines.begins: An otherworldly voice coming from Mount Kilkreath is commanding me to find a beacon and return it. It should be located in <Alias=GemContainerLocation>.

lines.name: The Cursed Tribe
lines.begins: I've heard rumors there's some kind of problem in the Orc settlement of Largashbur, southwest of Riften.

lines.name: The House of Horrors
lines.begins: Tyranus, a Vigilant of Stendarr, is investigating an old, abandoned house in Markarth. He believes it was once a site of daedric worship.

lines.name: The Innocence Lost - Quest Expansion
lines.begins: Ask a guard to arrest Grelod (Optional)

lines.name: The Mind of Madness
lines.begins: Dervenin wants me to talk to his master about returning from vacation. To do so, I need to gain entrance to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace.

lines.name: The Only Cure
lines.begins: A Khajiit named Kesh has offered to help me commune with Peryite. He asked me to acquire a deathbell flower, flawless ruby, silver ingot, and some vampire dust.

lines.name: The Taste of Death
lines.begins: Eola in Markarth wants me to join her in worshipping Namira, the Lady of Decay, by feasting on the flesh of the dead. She has something planned inside Reachcliff Cave.

lines.name: The Taste of Death - Quest Addon
lines.source: The Taste of Death - Quest Addon
lines.begins: I've read the journal of the cannibal who assaulted me. It revealed that Draugr drove them from Reachcliff Cave and that more cannibals are hiding in Markarth. The cave may hold clues to their identities.

lines.name: The Thalmor's Shadow - Taliesin (Custom Voiced Follower)
lines.source: The Thalmor's Shadow - Taliesin (Custom Voiced Follower)
lines.begins: I heard rumors about a statue of Talos hidden somewhere in the Falkreath area. Perhaps I could find some allies that could help me.

lines.name: The Whispering Door
lines.begins: Balgruuf the Greater, Jarl of Whiterun, has a troubled child. He's asked me to help the boy.

lines.name: Trad - AE - CC - Collection - Requiem Patch
lines.source: Trad - AE - CC - Collection - Requiem Patch
lines.begins: In my search for the secrets behind the divine power of the Tribunal and Dagoth Ur I have conducted a profane ritual twisting my flesh with corpus, removing my very heart with the tools of Kagrenac and infusing it with the power of heartstones and the lingering power of the masks of the Tribunal and Daogth Ur. Without a heart I will surely die there is no way forward but to place my tainted heart back in its place.

lines.name: Vittorias Alternate Wedding
lines.begins: I have been invited to attend the wedding reception of Vittoria Vici and Asgeir Snow-Shod, at the Temple of the Divines in Solitude.

lines.name: Waking Nightmare
lines.begins: I've overheard two citizens of Dawnstar complaining about horrible nightmares. They seem to be relying on a priest of Mara named Erandur for assistance.
